description: This file is a shell script for managing the DHCPv6 client service on a network device. It includes functions for starting, stopping, and updating the DHCPv6 client, handles various system events, and manages service registration and deregistration. The script configures the DHCPv6 client binary based on device type, and interacts with system properties and sysctl settings to control DHCPv6 behavior.

methods.name: service_init
methods.description: Initializes the service by retrieving system and sysconfig parameters and storing relevant configuration variables.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts the DHCPv6 client service if the conditions are met, choosing between different client binaries based on device type.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops the DHCPv6 client service safely, terminating processes or invoking the client binary's stop command.

methods.name: service_update
methods.description: Updates the DHCPv6 client state based on the current system configuration.

methods.name: register_dhcpv6_client_handler
methods.description: Registers system event handlers for DHCPv6 client relevant events.

methods.name: unregister_dhcpv6_client_handler
methods.description: Unregisters system event handlers related to DHCPv6 client management.

methods.name: service_enable
methods.description: Enables DHCPv6 client service and registers event handlers.

methods.name: service_disable
methods.description: Disables DHCPv6 client service and unregisters event handlers
